title: Karyal Jawaan Ki Laash Pay
body:
Karyal jawaan ki laash pay
Kitne sitam Hussain nay, tanha uthaay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Kia vakhth agaya hay Muhammad ki Aal par
Sehdania yay kehthi thi sar apna peet kar
Shabbir kiska khoon yay, rukh par lagaay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Taarikh Bhi Hussain ki ghurbat pay ro pari
Betay ki laash baap say run may na uth saki
Islam nay Hussain ko, Kya din dikhaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehmane Karbala pay qayamat guzargai
Akbar ki laash khoon may doobi hui mili
Nayzon kay zakhm Bhi Ali, Akbar nay khaaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Khayyam ahlebait may matam bapa hua
Zainab nay jab Hussain say roro kay yeh kaha
Maqtal may hum sagheer ko, dafna kay aaye hain
